messages.content: Answer using only the provided policy. Respond with a number only.

Policy: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Sale items may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Gift cards are non-refundable. Shipping fees are not refunded unless the item arrived damaged.

Question: How many days does a customer have to return a sale item?

Using the policy below, how many PTO days has Jordan accrued in total? Jordan works 32 hours a week, started exactly 4 months ago, and hasn't used any PTO. Answer with a number only.

PTO Policy
Full-time employees (30+ hrs/week) accrue 1.5 days of PTO per month. Part-time employees (under 30 hrs/week) accrue 0.75 days per month. Employees in their first 90 days accrue PTO but cannot use it. Unused PTO carries over to the next year, up to 5 days.

notes: must classify 32 hrs as full-time; 90-day rule and carryover cap are distractors
